newsitem.title: USA: SEC halts trade in Interactive Multimedia.
newsitem.headline: SEC halts trade in Interactive Multimedia.

text.p: The Securities and Exchange Commission said Wednesday it temporarily suspended trade in Interactive Multimedia Publishers Inc because of a lack of current and accurate information concerning its stock.
Trading in the Akron, Ohio-based company began at 0930 EST/1430 GMT on December 4 and lasts through December 17, the regulatory agency said.

The Commission said it ordered the trading ban because of questions that have been raised regarding the accuracy of disclosures concerning the company's corporate history and the tradability of its shares.
